findings.title: Removed public names from mark_failed without re-exports
findings.body: `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context` and `SimpleCheckIn` were all removed from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` and moved/renamed into new modules, with no backwards-compatible aliases. Any existing imports (e.g. tests patching `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence`, or code importing `SimpleCheckIn` from here) will fail at import time or silently stop patching the real code path. Either keep re-export aliases or update all call sites/tests in this PR.

findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context computes `config` copy but returns the raw config
findings.body: Lines 160-162 copy the monitor config and replace `schedule_type` with its display value, but the returned dict at line 168 uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of the modified `config`. The resulting occurrence context therefore reports the numeric schedule_type rather than the human-readable one, and the copy is dead code. (Carried over from the moved code, but easy to fix while relocating.)
